summary: Professional Diversity Network filed an 8-K reporting it regained Nasdaq compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). Nasdaq had notified the company on June 5, 2026 of non-compliance and granted until December 2, 2026 to cure; the closing bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from September 14 through September 25, 2026, prompting Nasdaq's September 28, 2026 notice closing the matter. A September 30, 2026 press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors apply; this is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation.
